game.name: Madden Nfl 10 (USA)(Demo)
game.desc: Play American football with Madden NFL 10 on Xbox 360. Make spectacular catches like a real receiver with the receiving moves. With defensive contacts you can make low blocks, rip the ball away or cut off passes with aerial contacts. Create your own NFL franchise: build your stadium, set concession prices, recruit your staff, draft players, and run the entire enterprise from start to finish.
